facts.value: The receiving institution must be a university with whom the University of Limerick has a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement.
Applicants should check with UL Global prior to submitting their application to ensure the partner institution holds a valid mobility agreement with UL.
A funded duration for staff mobility must be a minimum of 2 days (excluding travel).
A funded duration for staff mobility must be a maximum of 7 days (including travel).
Faculty attending a partner institution must fulfil a minimum of 8 teaching hours per week during their mobility.
